# HindiFontGen

> HindiFontGen is a free online Hindi font generator that lets users preview Hindi and other Devanagari-script text in different typefaces, customize text size and colours, apply visual effects, copy Unicode text, and download styled text as PNG or transparent PNG images. The website helps users choose suitable fonts for names, quotes, social media graphics, invitations, posters, greetings, and other creative designs.

HindiFontGen focuses on practical Hindi typography, readable Devanagari text, font previews, and image creation without requiring users to create an account.

## Main Website

- [HindiFontGen Homepage](https://hindifontgen.in/): Main Hindi font generator and guide to the website's features, font styles, customization options, and common uses.

## Font Generator Features

- [Hindi Font Generator](https://hindifontgen.in/): Type Hindi or English text and preview it in multiple Devanagari typefaces.
- [Text Customization and Effects](https://hindifontgen.in/): Adjust text size, text colour, background colour, and supported visual effects such as outline, shadow, glow, 3D, and gradient.
- [Copy Text and Download PNG](https://hindifontgen.in/): Copy plain Unicode text or export a styled text image, including a transparent PNG where supported.
- [Hindi Typography Guide](https://hindifontgen.in/): Learn about Devanagari font selection, matras, conjuncts, readability, and choosing typefaces for different design needs.

## Hindi Text and Font Information

- [Unicode Hindi Text](https://hindifontgen.in/): Understand how Unicode Devanagari text works and why changing a typeface does not convert text into a different encoding.
- [Font Selection Guide](https://hindifontgen.in/): Compare decorative, handwritten, bold, serif, and sans-serif styles for headings, names, invitations, and digital graphics.
- [Font Usage and Installation](https://hindifontgen.in/): Learn how to use downloaded PNG images in designs and how to obtain font files from their respective Google Fonts pages.
- [Troubleshooting Hindi Fonts](https://hindifontgen.in/): Find guidance for missing glyphs, matra spacing, conjunct rendering, clipboard formatting, and differences between previews and exported images.

## Policies and Website Information

- [Privacy Policy](https://hindifontgen.in/privacy-policy.html): Information about privacy and the website's handling of user data.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://hindifontgen.in/terms.html): Terms governing use of the website and its tools.
- [Disclaimer](https://hindifontgen.in/disclaimer.html): General information about the website, font previews, and use of its tools and content.
- [DMCA Policy](https://hindifontgen.in/dmca.html): Instructions for submitting copyright-related concerns about website content.

## Important Usage Notes

- The generator is intended to preview and style text, not to convert Unicode Hindi into legacy font encodings simply by changing the typeface.
- Copying text generally preserves the Unicode characters, not the visual font styling. Use a downloaded image when the exact appearance needs to be preserved.
- Font availability, glyph rendering, licensing, and supported features may vary by typeface. Users should consult the relevant font's licence before using it in commercial projects.
- The website describes its text previews and PNG creation as browser-based and states that the text entered into the generator is not saved by the tool. Refer to the Privacy Policy for the site's full privacy information.

## Optional

- [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/): External resource for exploring, downloading, and checking licences for supported font families.
